degree_definition: Number of distinct Lepidoptera species in the fixed HOSTS-WCVP reconstruction recorded using the plant.
interpretation: Plants prominent across the Lepidoptera-host network are disproportionately anthropogenically redistributed even after accounting for native geographic breadth and plant-family structure. This provides a plant-level explanation for why other-Lepidoptera-use weighting absorbs the simple butterfly host-identity excess.
claim_boundary: HOSTS consumer degree conflates ecological host commonness/breadth with study and recording intensity. The association identifies a network-prominence axis but cannot partition biological commonness from database visibility.
